pageProps.title: Houwseom Lotte Department Store Dongtan Branch
pageProps.review: We share an honest taste evaluation and visit review of representative menus such as thick garlic chip Ggu-ba-yuk and Xiao Long Bao tasted at the Chinese restaurant Houwseom at Lotte Department Store Dongtan Branch in Hwaseong-si, Gyeonggi-do.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Garlic Chip Ggu-ba-yuk", "rating": 4 } --- The meat is thick and delicious. ``` ```menu { "title": "Xiao Long Bao", "rating": 4 } --- It tastes good, but dim sum is expensive as expected. ``` ```menu { "title": "Ragu Jajang Dosakmyeon", "rating": 3 } --- The jajang is delicious, but personally, I don't like Dosakmyeon. ``` ## Review A place I often go to when I want to eat dim sum. Every time I go, I always order Ggu-ba-yuk. I want to eat a lot of dim sum, but it's a bit burdensome because of the price. But it is delicious. ## Pictures
